position.es: Gil Marer y Aweswell Limited alegan que el dictamen fiscal de 12 de marzo de 2019 fue, como mínimo, gravemente imprudente y pudo ser ya delictivo; que Ricardo de Mosteyrín Sampalo había cruzado el umbral penal antes o, a más tardar, durante la vista de 25 de julio de 2023; y que la posición y actuación institucionales proporcionaron un escudo al perímetro Acosta Matos/RICPE y han causado o contribuido a un daño patrimonial, procesal y reputacional continuado. Es una alegación atribuida, no una declaración de culpabilidad.
position.en: Gil Marer and Aweswell Limited allege that the 12 March 2019 Fiscal opinion was, at minimum, gravely reckless and may already have been criminal; that Ricardo de Mosteyrín Sampalo had crossed the criminal threshold before or, at the latest, during the 25 July 2023 hearing; and that the institutional position and conduct provided a shield to the Acosta Matos/RICPE perimeter and have caused or contributed to continuing patrimonial, procedural and reputational harm. This is an attributed allegation, not a finding of guilt.

dp1901.documented: A 12 July 2026 order transferred the admission question to Ministerio Fiscal in connection with DIP 2/2026. A later order dated 14 September 2026 records a prosecution report dated 29 July 2026 seeking dismissal and itself orders sobreseimiento libre/archive.
open: native court order and legal-notice metadata
dp1901.warning_es: Fiscalia queda expresamente advertida de la alegacion de Gil: cualquier acto u omision informado que suprima, fragmente, reclasifique, neutralice o deje sin investigar las alegaciones actor-especificas de delitos economicos de DP 1901/2026 puede habilitar activamente el esquema alegado, proteger a sus presuntos beneficiarios y contribuir al dano patrimonial continuado.
dp1901.warning_en: Fiscalia is expressly warned of Gil's allegation: any informed act or omission that suppresses, fragments, reclassifies, neutralises or leaves uninvestigated the actor-specific economic-crime allegations in DP 1901/2026 may actively enable the alleged scheme, protect its alleged beneficiaries and contribute to continuing patrimonial harm.

supervening_event.boundary: The dismissal request is a concrete dated prosecutorial act; it is not by itself proof of capture, prevarication, coordination or criminal liability.

evidence_boundaries: Public publication is not proof of formal service, institutional receipt or personal access.
Institutional receipt of earlier submissions is not automatic personal knowledge by Ricardo de Mosteyrín or another prosecutor.
DP 1901/2026 remains separate from Calificacion, DP 1956/2026, DIP 2/2026, RPL 2523/2025, Madrid DP 913/2025 and judicial or disciplinary routes.

The 14 September DP 1901 order records a 29 July prosecution report seeking dismissal and supplies the later judicial disposition; the signed prosecution report, author, source corpus, reasoning, routing trace and notice metadata remain unlocated in the controlled public record.
The adverse first-instance Judgment 163/2023 and unresolved RPL 2523/2025 appeal remain visible.
No guilt, common design, personal coordination, active enablement, causation or criminal liability is presented as adjudicated fact.
